scope: Strict native bundle v1 codec. The separate asset-overlay API and its test are outside WO-RUST-PROJECT-01.

types.evidence: test_error_names; error assertions across bundle tests

types.adaptation: Borrowed name/media/data slices; decoded data lifetime is tied to source bytes.
Borrowed slices and asset slice replace nullable pointer plus count; impossible states are excluded by safe references.
Borrowed validated source, asset_count and asset_at; base/overlay asset split is excluded with overlay behavior.
Success is Result::Ok; failures retain error, encoded_size, and error_offset. encoded_size returns Result<usize>.

functions.adaptation: encode_into preserves caller-buffer behavior; encode returns a fallibly allocated owned Vec. Rust borrowing prevents output/input aliasing, so C overlap rejection has no constructible safe call.

Returns Result<BundleView<'_>, BundleFailure> instead of writing through out_view; a null out_view has no Rust equivalent. Input bytes are a safe slice, so null/invalid pointer-length pairs are unrepresentable.
Accepts a byte slice rather than pointer-length pair.
Returns Option<Asset<'a>> instead of bool plus out parameter.
Rust enum prevents unknown discriminants; all eight defined C names are preserved.

behavior.c: CRC-32/IEEE and per-asset CRC over name, media type, and data
behavior.adaptation: A post-slice asset CRC failure reports the consumed record end offset, matching the C decoder cursor.

behavior.c: strict limits, checked sizing, duplicate rejection, full-record preflight
opaque metadata and byte-identical valid round trips
behavior.rust: Asset and BundleView borrowed byte slices
